text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I've proven to her that anyone<n>can be a hero
if they try hard enough,<n>and that I travel about for
the sake of<n>showing that truth to the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We receive some sudden news about<n>Taiki! After
the Yasuda Kinen, she<n>apparently plans to fly out to
France<n>to be the first to win a European G1!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
She's going after the same race as<n>me—the Prix
Jacques Le Marois! I<n>need to run against her in the
Yasuda<n>Kinen so I can compare the strength<n>of our
possibilities!
